items.q: Which digital marketing course should I join as a beginner?
items.a: Start with the Digital Marketing Course with GenAI. It covers SEO, social media, Google and Meta Ads, email and WhatsApp marketing and AI tools, and it needs no earlier experience.

items.q: Can I learn online, or only in Bhopal?
items.a: Both. The classroom Digital Marketing Course in Bhopal runs for 16 weeks at our MP Nagar campus, and the online course runs live for 20 weeks with a recording of every session.

items.q: Can I try a class before I enrol?
items.a: Yes. We run free live masterclasses regularly, and the online course lets you sit in on a live session before you decide. See the upcoming masterclasses.

items.q: How much does the course cost, and is EMI available?
items.a: The classroom Digital Marketing Course in Bhopal is ₹22,000 (it was ₹28,000), and EMI is available as 4 monthly installments of ₹5,500. Fees for the other programs are shared on request: fill in the form on this page or WhatsApp us on +91 84619 58162.

items.q: Will you help me get a job after the course?
items.a: Yes. Placement support covers resume building, interview preparation, mock interviews and portfolio guidance, with access to our network of 200+ hiring partners. Our last three batches recorded a 96% placement rate. Hiring decisions always stay with the employer.

items.q: Do I need a degree or a marketing background to join?
items.a: No. Students after 12th, graduates, working professionals, business owners, freelancers and career switchers all join, and the beginner program starts from the basics.

items.q: Will I get a certificate, and can employers check it?
items.a: Yes. Every learner who finishes a program gets a completion certificate. Anyone can confirm it on our Verify Certificate page.

items.q: Where can I see what your students do now?
items.a: Our Alumni page lists learners and the companies they work at, and the Reviews page has student and client stories.

items.q: What can eBuddha Digitech do for my business?
items.a: We run SEO, social media marketing, Google and Meta Ads, and website design and development, with one team handling all of it. See our Digital Marketing Services.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Bhopal?
items.a: Yes, across India and abroad. Calls, reviews and monthly reports all work remotely.

items.q: I want to hire your trained learners. Is it free?
items.a: Yes. Hiring from us is free for employers, with no recruitment fee. Send your role details on the Hire From Us page.

items.a: Since 2018. We have trained 21.5K+ learners and served 429+ brands. Read more about us.
